outcome_evidence: The oven door is closed at frame 0 in left_ego_image. Across frames 20–200, image and wrist_image show the gripper gradually repositioning toward the oven’s front/handle area. At frames 220–235, the gripper is near that area, but left_ego_image still shows the door upright and closed; no opening is visible. Completion is therefore unconfirmed in the observed episode, rather than established by a visibly failed grasp or pull. The slow approach and alignment do not alone establish a local failure.
